# Gregory Y. H. Lip

Gregory Y. H. Lip is credited in the AFDK 2024 report as the author of the ABC Pathway model for integrated management of atrial fibrillation, dated September 2017 [^src1]. The report presents this model as the conceptual basis for structured patient education under Indicator 8 (Struktureret patientuddannelse) in the AFDK program (Atrieflimren i Danmark), administered by Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram [^src1]. The ABC Pathway comprises three main components: stroke prevention (A), better symptom control (B), and reduction of cardiovascular risk (C), and is described as grounded in European ESC guidelines and Danish national recommendations [^src1].

The corpus contains only a single, brief mention of Lip — a citation line ("Gregory Y. H. Lip. Sept. 2017") within the chapter documenting patient education practices for atrial fibrillation [^src1]. No further biographical, institutional, or relational details about Lip are provided in the source material. No relationships or additional claims involving Lip appear elsewhere in the corpus.
